purpose: Source-agnostic Operating Cost truth wrapper that reuses Financial Truth V1 while separating recognized cost from payment, settlement proceeds, allocation context and budget context.
rules: Financial quality and canonical numeric truth are delegated to financial-truth.v1; TASK-067 does not create a second ACTUAL/ESTIMATE/GAP/NOT_CONNECTED system.
Recognized cost is not Cash paid. PAYMENT_SOURCE cannot produce recognized numeric Operating Cost truth.

SETTLEMENT_GROSS and SETTLEMENT_NET_PAYOUT are not platform-fee recognition. A SETTLEMENT_SOURCE can support ACTUAL only when the amount semantics are explicitly RECOGNIZED_COST and recognition proof passes.
Budget, plan, quote and allocation context cannot become ACTUAL recognition. They may produce ESTIMATE only when amount_semantics=ESTIMATED_COST and estimate_proven=true.
ACTUAL requires recognized-cost semantics plus proven actuality, recognition period, amount semantics and scope.
ACTUAL source_period and source_scope must exactly match the Financial Truth period and scope; historical evidence therefore cannot silently become current-period ACTUAL.
EXACT_ITEM may remain ACTUAL while wider period coverage is PARTIAL or missing, provided the exact item recognition gates pass.
PERIOD_AGGREGATE ACTUAL requires coverage.status=COMPLETE and coverage_proven=true.
GAP and NOT_CONNECTED always expose value=null. Missing numeric input never becomes zero; explicit proven zero is valid.
Operating-cost amounts are non-negative in V1. Negative or non-finite values fail closed; credits/rebates require later explicit mapper semantics rather than implicit sign inversion.
Unknown scope never becomes ALL; ALL is accepted only when Financial Truth aggregate_proven=true.
Shared/company OPEX cannot be represented as branch-specific recognized cost unless an allocation is explicitly applied and approved. Allocation context alone never creates ACTUAL recognition.
Purchase, supplier payment, payroll payment, FoodApp gross, net payout and customer delivery charge cannot become OPEX recognition merely by source presence.
Privacy-unsafe source/evidence/lineage/allocation labels fail closed; no Drive URLs/IDs, private rows, payment/account identifiers or secrets belong in public evidence.
Normalization is pure, deterministic and idempotent. The contract performs no source reading, aggregation, Profit calculation, Cash calculation, DB/RPC/write/UI action or connector call.
operatingCostTruthForBaseline accepts only PERIOD_AGGREGATE wrapper truth; exact items must be aggregated later by TASK-071 before entering Partial Financial Baseline.
